typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	CAERPTS_DATASOURCE as string (),
	CAERPTS_DB as string (),
	CAERPTS_PWD as string (),
	CAERPTS_USER as string (),
	MOBILE_DATASOURCE as string (),
	MOBILE_DB as string (),
	MOBILE_PWD as string (),
	MOBILE_USER as string (),
	OLTP_DATASOURCE as string (),
	OLTP_DB as string (),
	OLTP_PWD as string (),
	OLTP_USER as string (),
	v_Archive as string (),
	v_ExcelSQL as string (),
	v_FileExists as string (),
	v_IsArchive as integer (),
	v_MonthDecrement as integer (),
	v_SourceID as integer (),
	v_SRCFile as string (),
	v_SRCFileArchive as string (),
	v_SRCFileName as string (),
	v_SRCFilePath as string (),
	v_SRCFolder as string ()
}

source(output(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		CALL_DATETIME as timestamp,
		ROWNUM as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT SUBSCRIBER_ID,CALL_DATETIME,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY SUBSCRIBER_ID ORDER BY CALL_DATETIME) ROWNUM   FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIBER_ID,CALL_DATETIME FROM [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS_STAGE]   WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EXIST=0)X  ORDER BY SUBSCRIBER_ID,CALL_DATETIME',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSRCStage	source(output(
		ATTEMPT as integer,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SBSB_ROWNUM),0) ATTEMPT ,IOS.SUBSCRIBER_ID AS SBSB_ID  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIBER_ID FROM [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS_STAGE] WITH (NOLOCK)) IOS    LEFT JOIN [APP_RPTS].[MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS] MHC WITH (NOLOCK) ON IOS.SUBSCRIBER_ID=MHC.SUBSCRIBER_ID   GROUP BY IOS.SUBSCRIBER_ID  ORDER BY SBSB_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCLASTATTEMPT	source(output(
		CID as integer,
		subscriber_id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT CID , subscriber_id   FROM CKOLTP.MEMBER_COVERAGE WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY subscriber_id',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPCOVERAGECIDLKPTABLE	source(output(
		ROWNUM as integer,
		SPLIT_NUM as integer,
		TIMEADD as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ROWNUM,SPLIT_NUM,TIMEADD FROM APP_RPTS.MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS_SPLIT_CONFIG WITH(NOLOCK)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIGLKPTABLE
OLEDBSRCStage derive({Copy of SUBSCRIBER_ID} = toString(SUBSCRIBER_ID)) ~> DCSBSBID
DCSBSBID,LKPCOVERAGECIDLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of SUBSCRIBER_ID} == LKPCOVERAGECIDLKPTABLE@subscriber_id,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPCOVERAGECID
LKPCOVERAGECID filter(isMatch()) ~> FilterLKPCOVERAGECID
FilterLKPCOVERAGECID,SRCLASTATTEMPT join(SUBSCRIBER_ID == SBSB_ID,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MJATTEMPT
MJATTEMPT derive(CALL_DATETIME = CALL_DATETIME,
		ROWNUM = ROWNUM,
		DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID = DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		ATTEMPT = ATTEMPT,
		CID = CID) ~> MJATTEMPTREFORMAT1
MJATTEMPTREFORMAT1 derive(DC_CURRENTROW = (iif(isNull(ATTEMPT), 0, ATTEMPT)) + ROWNUM) ~> DVCCURRENTROW
DVCCURRENTROW derive({Copy of DC_CURRENTROW} = toInteger(DC_CURRENTROW)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIGLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of DC_CURRENTROW} == LKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIGLKPTABLE@ROWNUM,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIG
LKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIG select(mapColumn(
		{Copy of DC_CURRENTROW} = {Copy of DC_CURRENTROW},
		DC_CURRENTROW = DC_CURRENTROW,
		CALL_DATETIME = CALL_DATETIME,
		ROWNUM = LKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIGLKPTABLE@ROWNUM,
		DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID = DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		ATTEMPT = ATTEMPT,
		CID = CID,
		SPLIT_NUM = SPLIT_NUM,
		TIMEADD = TIMEADD
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIGSelect
LKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIGSelect filter(isMatch()) ~> FilterLKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIG
FilterLKPMAHRAATTEMPTSPLITCONFIG derive({Copy of DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID} = toString(DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID)) ~> DCSUBSCRIBERID
DCSUBSCRIBERID sink(input(
		ATTEMPT as short,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		TIMEADD as integer,
		ATTEMPT_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CID as integer,
		SBSB_ROWNUM as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ATTEMPT = SPLIT_NUM,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = {Copy of DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID},
		TIMEADD,
		ATTEMPT_DATE = CALL_DATETIME,
		CID,
		SBSB_ROWNUM = ROWNUM)) ~> DSTHRACALLATTEMPTS
